// Code generated by gofastr-native inspect. It exists only in a -overlay
// for one go build and is never written into the module.

package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
[[if .Registry]]
	nativeui "github.com/DonaldMurillo/gofastr-native/nativeui"
[[end]]
	target [[printf "%q" .Package]]
)

type hello struct {
	Minimum      int               `json:"minimum"`
	Maximum      int               `json:"maximum"`
	Renderer     string            `json:"renderer"`
	Capabilities map[string]string `json:"capabilities"`
}

type profile struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Hello hello  `json:"hello"`
}

type plan struct {
	DataDir      string    `json:"dataDir"`
	ResultPath   string    `json:"resultPath"`
	Start        string    `json:"start"`
	Depth        int       `json:"depth"`
	MaxScreens   int       `json:"maxScreens"`
	MaxLinks     int       `json:"maxLinks"`
	Profiles     []profile `json:"profiles"`
	Capabilities []string  `json:"capabilities"`
	Codes        []string  `json:"codes"`
	FieldKinds   []string  `json:"fieldKinds"`
}

type command struct {
	Version    int    `json:"version"`
	Kind       string `json:"kind"`
	Connection string `json:"connection,omitempty"`
	Instance   string `json:"instance,omitempty"`
	Route      string `json:"route,omitempty"`
	Hello      *hello `json:"hello,omitempty"`
}

type reply struct {
	Connection string `json:"connection"`
	Instance   string `json:"instance"`
	Error      *struct {
		Code    string `json:"code"`
		Message string `json:"message"`
	} `json:"error"`
	Screen json.RawMessage `json:"screen"`
}

type rawField struct {
	Kind     string            `json:"kind"`
	Required bool              `json:"required"`
	Options  []json.RawMessage `json:"options"`
}

// rawScreen decodes only structure. Titles, labels, text and values are
// never decoded into anything the harness keeps.
type rawScreen struct {
	Actions []json.RawMessage `json:"actions"`
	List    *struct {
		Rows []struct {
			Destination string `json:"destination"`
			Disabled    bool   `json:"disabled"`
		} `json:"rows"`
		SearchKey   string           `json:"searchKey"`
		Filters     []rawField       `json:"filters"`
		Selection   *json.RawMessage `json:"selection"`
		Paging      *json.RawMessage `json:"paging"`
		Refreshable bool             `json:"refreshable"`
		Empty       string           `json:"empty"`
	} `json:"list"`
	Form *struct {
		Fields []rawField       `json:"fields"`
		Draft  *json.RawMessage `json:"draft"`
	} `json:"form"`
	Text        string            `json:"text"`
	FilePreview *json.RawMessage  `json:"filePreview"`
	Images      []json.RawMessage `json:"images"`
	Attachments []json.RawMessage `json:"attachments"`
	Requires    []struct {
		Capability    string `json:"capability"`
		AllowFallback bool   `json:"allowFallback"`
	} `json:"requires"`
	Tabs []struct {
		Route string `json:"route"`
	} `json:"tabs"`
	Live       *json.RawMessage  `json:"live"`
	Components []json.RawMessage `json:"components"`
	Protection *json.RawMessage  `json:"protection"`
}

type requirement struct {
	Capability    string `json:"capability"`
	AllowFallback bool   `json:"allowFallback,omitempty"`
}

type component struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Count int    `json:"count"`
}

type outline struct {
	Content        string         `json:"content"`
	Protected      bool           `json:"protected,omitempty"`
	Live           bool           `json:"live,omitempty"`
	Draft          bool           `json:"draft,omitempty"`
	Requires       []requirement  `json:"requires,omitempty"`
	Actions        int            `json:"actions,omitempty"`
	ActionIDs      []string       `json:"actionIds,omitempty"`
	Fields         map[string]int `json:"fields,omitempty"`
	RequiredFields int            `json:"requiredFields,omitempty"`
	Rows           int            `json:"rows,omitempty"`
	DisabledRows   int            `json:"disabledRows,omitempty"`
	RowActionIDs   []string       `json:"rowActionIds,omitempty"`
	Search         bool           `json:"search,omitempty"`
	Filters        int            `json:"filters,omitempty"`
	Selection      bool           `json:"selection,omitempty"`
	Paging         bool           `json:"paging,omitempty"`
	Refreshable    bool           `json:"refreshable,omitempty"`
	Tabs           int            `json:"tabs,omitempty"`
	Components     int            `json:"components,omitempty"`
	ComponentNames []component    `json:"componentNames,omitempty"`
	Images         int            `json:"images,omitempty"`
	Attachments    int            `json:"attachments,omitempty"`
	Destinations   []string       `json:"destinations,omitempty"`
	Links          []string       `json:"links,omitempty"`
	LinksOmitted   int            `json:"linksOmitted,omitempty"`
}

type screen struct {
	ID         string   `json:"id"`
	Pattern    string   `json:"pattern,omitempty"`
	Parent     string   `json:"parent,omitempty"`
	Depth      int      `json:"depth"`
	Status     string   `json:"status"`
	Code       string   `json:"code,omitempty"`
	Capability string   `json:"capability,omitempty"`
	Outline    *outline `json:"outline,omitempty"`
}

type result struct {
	Profile   string   `json:"profile"`
	Renderer  string   `json:"renderer"`
	Connected bool     `json:"connected"`
	Code      string   `json:"code,omitempty"`
	Screens   []screen `json:"screens"`
	Unvisited int      `json:"unvisited"`
}

// failure names where the harness stopped and the Go types of the error
// chain. It never holds an error message or panic value.
type failure struct {
	Phase   string `json:"phase"`
	Profile string `json:"profile,omitempty"`
	Screen  string `json:"screen,omitempty"`
	Cause   string `json:"cause"`
}

type output struct {
	Results []result `json:"results"`
	Failure *failure `json:"failure,omitempty"`
}

var capabilityName = regexp.MustCompile(`[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*/v[0-9]+`)

var known struct {
	capabilities, codes, kinds map[string]bool
}

func set(values []string) map[string]bool {
	out := make(map[string]bool, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		out[value] = true
	}
	return out
}

func knownCode(code string) string {
	if known.codes[code] {
		return code
	}
	return "other"
}

// ids maps concrete routes to opaque screen identifiers. It is shared by
// every profile, so one screen keeps one identifier across the report.
// Concrete routes never leave this process.
var ids = map[string]string{}

func idFor(route string) string {
	if id, ok := ids[route]; ok {
		return id
	}
	id := "s" + strconv.Itoa(len(ids)+1)
	ids[route] = id
	return id
}

func cause(err error) string {
	var types []string
	for err != nil && len(types) < 4 {
		types = append(types, fmt.Sprintf("%T", err))
		err = errors.Unwrap(err)
	}
	return strings.Join(types, ">")
}

// guard runs app code and turns an error or panic into a failure that
// holds only fixed names and Go type names.
func guard(phase string, run func() error) (stopped *failure) {
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			stopped = &failure{Phase: phase, Cause: "panic"}
		}
	}()
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		return &failure{Phase: phase, Cause: cause(err)}
	}
	return nil
}

// send is the only way this harness reaches the app's protocol. It
// refuses every kind except hello, open and close, so no action,
// checkpoint, effect receipt or device service can run.
func send(c command) (reply, error) {
	switch c.Kind {
	case "hello", "open", "close":
	default:
		return reply{}, errors.New("inspect harness refused a command kind")
	}
	c.Version = 1
	payload, err := json.Marshal(c)
	if err != nil {
		return reply{}, err
	}
	raw, err := target.Command(string(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return reply{}, err
	}
	var decoded reply
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &decoded); err != nil {
		return reply{}, errors.New("inspect harness could not decode a reply")
	}
	return decoded, nil
}

func structure(raw rawScreen) *outline {
	out := &outline{Protected: raw.Protection != nil, Live: raw.Live != nil, Actions: len(raw.Actions), Tabs: len(raw.Tabs),
		Components: len(raw.Components), Images: len(raw.Images), Attachments: len(raw.Attachments)}
	switch {
	case raw.List != nil:
		out.Content = "list"
	case raw.Form != nil:
		out.Content = "form"
	case raw.FilePreview != nil:
		out.Content = "file-preview"
	case raw.Text != "":
		out.Content = "text"
	case len(raw.Components) != 0:
		out.Content = "components"
	default:
		out.Content = "none"
	}
	for _, need := range raw.Requires {
		if known.capabilities[need.Capability] {
			out.Requires = append(out.Requires, requirement{Capability: need.Capability, AllowFallback: need.AllowFallback})
		}
	}
	countFields := func(fields []rawField) {
		for _, field := range fields {
			kind := field.Kind
			if !known.kinds[kind] {
				kind = "other"
			}
			if out.Fields == nil {
				out.Fields = map[string]int{}
			}
			out.Fields[kind]++
			if field.Required {
				out.RequiredFields++
			}
		}
	}
	if raw.Form != nil {
		out.Draft = raw.Form.Draft != nil
		countFields(raw.Form.Fields)
	}
	if raw.List != nil {
		out.Rows = len(raw.List.Rows)
		for _, row := range raw.List.Rows {
			if row.Disabled {
				out.DisabledRows++
			}
		}
		out.Search, out.Filters = raw.List.SearchKey != "", len(raw.List.Filters)
		out.Selection, out.Paging, out.Refreshable = raw.List.Selection != nil, raw.List.Paging != nil, raw.List.Refreshable
	}
	return out
}

[[if .Registry]]
var registry *nativeui.App

// registered adds what the app's own registry vouches for: action IDs the
// route registers, compiled component names and registered destination
// patterns. nativeui.Outline drops everything else.
func registered(out *outline, raw json.RawMessage) {
	var decoded nativeui.Screen
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &decoded) != nil {
		return
	}
	described := nativeui.Outline(registry, decoded)
	for _, action := range described.Actions {
		out.ActionIDs = append(out.ActionIDs, action.ID)
	}
	if described.List != nil {
		out.RowActionIDs = described.List.RowActions
	}
	for _, named := range described.Components {
		out.ComponentNames = append(out.ComponentNames, component{Name: named.Name, Count: named.Count})
	}
	out.Destinations = described.Destinations
}
[[end]]

func walk(p plan, pr profile) (result, *failure) {
	out := result{Profile: pr.Name, Renderer: pr.Hello.Renderer, Screens: []screen{}}
	stop := func(f *failure, id string) (result, *failure) {
		f.Profile, f.Screen = pr.Name, id
		return out, f
	}
	h := pr.Hello
	var connected reply
	if f := guard("hello", func() (err error) { connected, err = send(command{Kind: "hello", Hello: &h}); return }); f != nil {
		return stop(f, "")
	}
	if connected.Error != nil {
		out.Code = knownCode(connected.Error.Code)
		return out, nil
	}
	out.Connected = true
	type item struct {
		route, id, parent string
		depth             int
	}
	queue := []item{{route: p.Start, id: idFor(p.Start)}}
	seen := map[string]bool{p.Start: true}
	for len(queue) > 0 {
		if len(out.Screens) >= p.MaxScreens {
			out.Unvisited = len(queue)
			break
		}
		next := queue[0]
		queue = queue[1:]
		var opened reply
		if f := guard("open", func() (err error) {
			opened, err = send(command{Kind: "open", Connection: connected.Connection, Route: next.route})
			return
		}); f != nil {
			return stop(f, next.id)
		}
		entry := screen{ID: next.id, Parent: next.parent, Depth: next.depth}
		[[if .Registry]]
		if pattern, ok := registry.RoutePattern(next.route); ok {
			entry.Pattern = pattern
		}
		[[end]]
		var raw rawScreen
		switch {
		case opened.Error != nil:
			entry.Status, entry.Code = "refused", knownCode(opened.Error.Code)
			if opened.Error.Code == "unsupported" {
				if name := capabilityName.FindString(opened.Error.Message); known.capabilities[name] {
					entry.Capability = name
				}
			}
		case len(opened.Screen) == 0 || string(opened.Screen) == "null":
			entry.Status = "empty"
		case json.Unmarshal(opened.Screen, &raw) != nil:
			return stop(&failure{Phase: "open", Cause: "undecodable-screen"}, next.id)
		default:
			entry.Status = "ok"
			entry.Outline = structure(raw)
			[[if .Registry]]
			registered(entry.Outline, opened.Screen)
			[[end]]
			var links []string
			for _, tab := range raw.Tabs {
				links = append(links, tab.Route)
			}
			if raw.List != nil {
				for _, row := range raw.List.Rows {
					if row.Destination != "" && !row.Disabled {
						links = append(links, row.Destination)
					}
				}
			}
			listed := map[string]bool{}
			for _, link := range links {
				if id, ok := ids[link]; ok && listed[id] {
					continue
				}
				if len(listed) >= p.MaxLinks {
					entry.Outline.LinksOmitted++
					continue
				}
				id := idFor(link)
				listed[id] = true
				entry.Outline.Links = append(entry.Outline.Links, id)
				if next.depth < p.Depth && !seen[link] {
					seen[link] = true
					queue = append(queue, item{route: link, id: id, parent: next.id, depth: next.depth + 1})
				}
			}
			sort.Slice(entry.Outline.Links, func(i, j int) bool {
				a, _ := strconv.Atoi(entry.Outline.Links[i][1:])
				b, _ := strconv.Atoi(entry.Outline.Links[j][1:])
				return a < b
			})
		}
		out.Screens = append(out.Screens, entry)
		if opened.Instance != "" {
			if f := guard("close", func() error {
				_, err := send(command{Kind: "close", Connection: connected.Connection, Instance: opened.Instance})
				return err
			}); f != nil {
				return stop(f, next.id)
			}
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

func main() {
	// App output never reaches inspect. The parent connects stdout and
	// stderr to the null device as well; this covers code that writes
	// through os.Stdout, os.Stderr or the standard logger.
	if null, err := os.OpenFile(os.DevNull, os.O_WRONLY, 0); err == nil {
		os.Stdout, os.Stderr = null, null
	}
	log.SetOutput(io.Discard)
	var p plan
	if err := json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin).Decode(&p); err != nil || p.ResultPath == "" {
		os.Exit(3)
	}
	known.capabilities, known.codes, known.kinds = set(p.Capabilities), set(p.Codes), set(p.FieldKinds)
	out := output{Results: []result{}}
	out.Failure = run(&p, &out)
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(out)
	if err != nil {
		os.Exit(4)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(p.ResultPath, encoded, 0o600); err != nil {
		os.Exit(5)
	}
}

func run(p *plan, out *output) *failure {
	if f := guard("start", func() error { return target.Start(p.DataDir) }); f != nil {
		return f
	}
	stopped := func() *failure { return guard("stop", target.Stop) }
	[[if .Registry]]
	if f := guard("inspect-app", func() error {
		registry = target.InspectApp()
		if registry == nil {
			return errors.New("InspectApp returned nil")
		}
		return nil
	}); f != nil {
		stopped()
		return f
	}
	[[end]]
	if p.Start == "" {
		if f := guard("root", func() error { p.Start = target.Root(); return nil }); f != nil {
			stopped()
			return f
		}
	}
	var failed *failure
	for _, pr := range p.Profiles {
		walked, f := walk(*p, pr)
		out.Results = append(out.Results, walked)
		if f != nil {
			failed = f
			break
		}
	}
	if f := stopped(); f != nil && failed == nil {
		failed = f
	}
	return failed
}
